The negative polarity conductor on the other side of the tower has a certain weakening effect on the lightning inducing ability of the positive polarity conductor close to the high voltage electrode, but has little effect on the shielding performance of the lightning conductor and the ground. The discharge process is analyzed based on the observations of high-speed cameras, and the synchronous analysis of voltage waveform is carried out. The inhibition of the negative polarity voltage of the conductor on the initiation and development of the upward streamer and the development of the downward leader is explained.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Grounding Mode of Secondary Cable Shielding Layer of UHV Converter Station
abstract: Because of a lightning strike, short circuit fault, and switch operation, grounding grid will be impacted by high-frequency current, which makes the grounding grid appear uneven distribution of transient grounding potential, this kind of transient grounding potential rise will be coupled to the core wire through the outer surface of the cable and will invade the secondary system, which may have an impact on the normal operation of the secondary equipment and Endanger the safe and stable operation of substation or converter station. In addition, with the digitalization, electronization, and localization of the secondary equipment in the UHV converter station, a large number of precision secondary equipment used for protection, control and communication is placed in the high-voltage switching field of the converter station, which greatly increases the probability of interference with the secondary system of the UHV converter station. It is well known that using shielded cables and choosing correct grounding mode of the shielding layer is an important measure to improve the electromagnetic compatibility of converter stations. In this paper, based on a test method to research transient grounding potential rise in converter station, the transient overvoltage of multi-segment secondary cables and their shielding layer with different grounding modes are measured in the field of an AC filter in a UHV converter station. The test results show that the grounding of the shielding layer between the first and the last sections is the key to suppress transient overvoltage for the multi-segment control cable. The best grounding method is to increase the shielding layer and armor layer of the control cable between the on-site control cabinet to be grounded at the single end of the B-phase on-site control cabinet based on the cable grounding mode. That is to say, the cable of the shielding layer and the armor layer between the on-site control cabinet should consider the grounding at the signal gathering point.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Impact Grounding Characteristics of Transmission Line Tower
abstract: There is a big difference between the impact grounding impedance and the power frequency grounding impedance. The measurement of the power frequency grounding impedance alone cannot effectively reflect the impact characteristics of the grounding body under lightning. In this paper, the effects of the impact current amplitude, injection point and soil resistivity on the impact characteristics of the transmission line tower grounding grid model are studied by means of simulation test. The results show that the grounding impedance of the grounding body decreases with the increase of the amplitude of the injected current. The impact coefficient of the grounding body is larger than that of the multi-point injection when the single current is injected. The lower the soil resistivity, the lower the impact coefficient of the grounding grid. The research results of this paper can provide reference data for proposing and verifying the new tower grounding impedance measurement principle and test equipment.

articleTitle: An Experimental Study on the Positive Streamer Leader Propagation under Switching Impulse Voltages in a 10m Rod-Plane Air Gap
abstract: A large-scale investigation into leader development in a 10-m rod-plane gap with different rise time 250 μs, 1000μs and 2500μs. To explain the leader propagation under switching impulse voltages, the leader propagation is recorded with a high-speed charge-coupled device (CCD) camera. It is significant to figure out this phenomenon to deepen our understanding of leader discharge. The observation results showed that the leader mechanism is a very complex physical phenomenon. It could be classified into two types of leader processes continuous and the discontinuous leader streamer-leader propagation. Furthermore, we studied the continuous leader development parameters, including two dimensional (2-D) leader length, injected charge, and final jump stage under switching impulse. We observed that the discontinuous leader makes an important contribution to the appearance of channel re-illuminations of the positive leader. Finally, the comparative study shows better results in terms of standard switch impulse and long front positive impulse in this study.

articleTitle: Comparison and Analysis of Lightning Overvoltage by Grounding; Methods between Wind Turbines
abstract: In this study, the lightning overvoltages for different grounding methods are compared and analyzed. There are many grounding methods to prevent lightning damage to wind turbines. In this study, three grounding methods are considered: an independent grounding method and two common grounding methods. Independent grounding refers to the separate grounding of each facility that requires grounding. Common grounding is the integrated grounding of various facilities. The first method to implement common grounding is to group the grounds of each device together. The second method is to connect the existing independent grounds using a concatenation. The analysis of the lightning overvoltages for each grounding method is presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Calculation Research on the Distance Between the Grounding wire and Conducting wire of the Middle Span for ±800kV Transmission Lines
abstract: -For overhead transmission lines, the insulation coordination of the grounding wire and conducting wire depends on the size of tower-head and the minimum safe distance between the grounding wire and conducting wire of the middle-span, which is related to the lightning current steepness, the length of the span, and the coupling coefficient between the conducting wire and grounding wire, etc. GB 50790-2013 〈Code for designing of ± 800kV DC overhead transmission line〉(In Chinese) points out that the distance between the grounding wire and conducting wire of the middle-span should be determined by mathematical computation, but does not give exact computation method, only a suggested formula is given in the appendix, which does not consider the influence factors such as the lightning current steepness, the coupling coefficient between the conducting wire and grounding wire, and so on. For this reason, this paper introduced a method named wave processing analysis (WPA), to make up for the shortness of the formula suggested by GB 50790-2013. To prove the rationality of WPA method, the distance between the grounding wire and conducting wire of the middle-span for a ±800kV UHVAC transmission project has been computed by those two methods mentioned above. Results showed that the distances obtained by the suggested formula does not satisfy the requirement of lightning withstand level, while WPA method can consider this requirement, so WPA method is a better method to determine the distance between the conducting wire and grounding wire of the middle-span. The calculation principle of WPA method can also be used to calculate the distance between the grounding wire and conducting wire of the middle span for other voltage level DC &AC transmission lines.

articleTitle: Comparison of Lightning Optical Observation of Shenzhen Tower on the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Lightning Location System
abstract: The paper Introduced the validating results of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao lightning location system based on 3 High-speed camera recorded flashes striking the Shenzhen Meteorological Gradient Tower. The GD-HK-MC-LLS is one of the based source of the lightning warning system in Shenzhen. Based on the analysis of both data in these 3 flashes, it is shown that the the lightning return stroke detection efficiency of this LLS is about 92.9% and the lightning return stroke loaction error is better than 300 meters. The cloud ground flash identification accuracy is 84.6%, however, we found that the first RS on HSC data was always not recorded as the first RS in the LLS database, indicated a pointed improvement of the LLS is needed.

articleTitle: Measurements and Analysis of Terrestrial Gamma-Ray Flashes (TGFs) within China
abstract: Terrestrial gamma-ray flashes (TGFs) are impulsive (~1 ms) but intense sources of gamma-rays associated with lightning activity and thunderstorms. Till now, few observation/study for those TGFs occurred in China are carried out. From June 2013, we started to install high sensitivity magnetic sensors in China and collected the lightning waveforms and other data related with TGF that detected by Fermi. Here we mainly introduce one special TGF occurred in South China which had three-station magnetic recordings. The results show that the TGF-related sferic is an energetic in-cloud pulse (EIP), with high current of 204.5 kA and the altitude at about 10 km. The characteristics of TGF parent thunderstorm are also discussed with comprehensive data of weather radar, Black Body Temperature (TBB), lightning location and weather sounding.

articleTitle: A 4-year Timeliness Analysis of the Lightning Waming in Shenzhen China
abstract: In this paper, a statistical analysis of the lightning warning in Shenzhen from 2014 to 2017 is conducted. Based on 115 lightning cases with the number of lightning larger than 100, the duration of lightning warning signals and the lifecycle of lightning activities are detailedly analyzed. The results show that, the issuing time of lightning warning signals by Shenzhen Municipal Meteorological Observatory is averagely 31.7 minutes earlier than the initial lightning. Moreover, most of the lightning warning signals are issued between June and August each year, accounting for more than 60% of the cases in the whole year. It is also found that, the lag time of cancelling warning signals in the early rainy season is significantly shorter than that in the latter rainy season. Also, according to the observational data, there is still ample room for the improvement of the lag time, especially when the lightning frequency is relatively small. Finally, the conclusions put forward effective strategies to improve the timeliness of the lightning warning signals.

Author Keywords: lag time of cancelling warning signals

articleTitle: Analysis of Red Sprites in the Middle and High Latitudes of China
abstract: In order to further study sprites in the middle and high latitude of China and reveal the relationship between sprite and thunderstorm. This paper introduces the observation experiment conducted in Liaoyuan, Jilin in summer of 2017. The results show that 17 sprite events occurred over a mesoscale convective system (MCS), and 9 sprite events occurred in three relatively small-scale MCSs. Their parent lightning located in the edge of the convective core region and there was no large stratiform cloud precipitation region in MCSs. In addition, all sprites captured are generated by positive cloud-to-ground (CG) strokes.

Author Keywords: The middle and high latitudes of China

articleTitle: An Inversion Method for Evaluating Charge Distribution in Thunderclouds Based on Doppler Radar and Electric Field Mill
abstract: In order to make the thundercloud charge structure research can be applied to practical applications, such as lightning warning and lightning protection design, it is a feasible way to invert the thundercloud charge structure by using ground observation data. Traditional inversion methods based only on electric field data are difficult to put into application due to the unacceptable inaccuracy and the large amount of demanded devices. To solve this problem, this paper proposed an inversion method based on the combination of Doppler radar and electric field mill, present a new disk-point model and a technique to locate thundercloud by Doppler radar. Inversions in different methods are deduced to make a comparison. the result shows that the new inversion method with disc-point model and the addition of radar data improves the accuracy of the results and shortens the calculation time.

articleTitle: Lightning Characteristics of Tropical Storm Bebinca (2013) and Super Typhoon Rammasun (2014)
abstract: The World Wide Lightning Location Network (WWLLN) data was used to analyze the lightning activities of Tropical Storm Bebinca (2013) and Super Typhoon Rammasun (2014). The relationships between lightning activity and cyclonic intensity change, direction of storm motion of the two tropical cyclones were also investigated. Preliminary analyses showed that the two systems produced a large number of lightning strokes in the region of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0\sim800\ km$</tex> from the centers, the numbers are 111,289 and 125,046 for Bebinca and Rammasun, and the average lightning stroke rate of Bebinca was 1021 str/h and that of Rammasun was 680 str/h. Both for Bebinca and Rammasun, their lightning frequency were oscillating in the whole lives, however, it was varied little for Rammasun and decreased for Bebinca. The radial and spatial distribution of lightning showed that the lightning of Bebinca mainly appeared at rain band outside of 300 km and most of lightning occurred at the west of cyclone. For Rammasun, lightning mainly produced in the regions of 160 km away from center, including the inner rainband and outer rainband, and mainly centralized in the west of cyclone. When the area around each storm was divided into four quadrants with respect to storm motion, right and left front, and right and left rear, the maximum number of flashes occurred in the left-rear quadrant of Bebinca, while in the right-front and left-front quadrant of Rammasun. The relationship between lightning frequency and intensity change for Bebinca was weak, while strong for Rammasun. The moving directions of Bebinca and Rammasun exhibited a weak relationship with lightning frequency, but well correlated with lightning spatial distribution.

articleTitle: Impulse Characteristics of Model Grounding Electrodes for a Transmission Tower-Footing Base Structure
abstract: The analysis of dynamic behavior of the transmission tower-footing base structure subjected to lightning currents is very important for the insulation design of transmission lines. We conducted a model experiment to propose a technique to investigate the dynamic characteristics of the ground resistance and the impulse response characteristics of the transmission tower-footing structure when soil ionization occurs due to the high surge current injected into the grounding electrode. The impulse characteristics of the ground resistance were measured and analyzed by using a hemispherical grounding electrode and a scale-down model grounding electrode of the transmission tower-footing base structure. Based on the model experiment using a scaling rule, we propose a method to estimate the impulse response of the actual transmission tower-footing structure.

articleTitle: Historical Transition of Location Accuracy of the JLDN
abstract: Location accuracy of the Japanese Lightning Detection Network (JLDN) has been discussed for many years. Meanwhile, some techniques to improve location error of lightning position had been developed. The length of semi-maj or of error ellipse is an approximate index to evaluate location accuracy in the region. Therefore, we analyzed length of semi-major axis of error ellipse estimated by JLDN to evaluate location accuracy between 2004 and 2016 in this paper. In the result, we could confirm that location accuracy of JLDN was improved by the propagation delay correction employed in January 2016. We also found that location accuracy relatively become low when the region was outside of sensor network. When the number of sensors participating in locating lightning discharge was small, the location accuracy tended to be lower than when that was large. We showed approximate location accuracy of JLDN was 0.37 km in the four main lands of Japan in 2016.

articleTitle: Innovative Protection Measures for Lightning Accidents Occurred in 10 kV Distribution Network of Jinzhai Area
abstract: The tripping frequency of 10kV distribution network line in Jinzhai County, caused by lightning accidents, is increasing in recent years. Effective protection measures to reduce the risks of line tripping becomes necessary. In this paper, statistics analyses on the events of lightning fall in Jinzhai area occurred in recent years were made. Damages caused by lightning accidents on distribution network were discussed in terms of distribution of lightning density and distribution of ground lightning intensity. The changing trend of line tripping caused by lightning accidents in recent years was studied, in comparison with the lightning withstand level of distribution network line at present. The results show that in the past three years, the increase of line tripping events is mainly due to the increase of ground lightning density and intensity in Jinzhai area. Lightning protection measures which mount lightning arresters on local poles and towers are confirmed to have limited effects on improving lightning protection performance on the whole 10kV distribution network, an innovative lightning protection scheme is put forward. The scheme could introduce improvement in insulation levels by installing Insulated cross arm in distribution network. The line model is simulated in EMTP. The performances of lightning protection before and after the application of the scheme are compared. The simulation results show that the innovative scheme can effectively improve the lightning resistance level of the entire line system. Following the above simulation results, the threats to the safety of substation operation, caused by the improvement of line insulation level, are further analyzed. The possible solutions for the threats are provided.

articleTitle: Design and Application of PCB-mounted SPDs for PV Inverters
abstract: This article analyzes the safety of the design and application of printed circuit board mounted (PCB-mounted) surge protective devices (SPD) used in the AC side and DC side of photovoltaic inverters (PV inverters). By combining the specific application environment of PV inverter systems, this article provides some points to be considered when designing and applying the PCB-mounted SPDs, for ensuring the application safety of PCB-mounted SPDs.

Author Keywords: isolation between main circuit and secondary circuit

articleTitle: Field Test of Lightning Performance at DC Traction Substation
abstract: Field test results of transient performance at a DC traction substation are reported in this paper. The test simulates an invasion of a lightning surge from one of phases of an AC grid. An arrester installed at a bus of AC side is discharged, and the discharge current is injected into the grounding mesh via a grounding wire for the surge arrester. The voltages on the primary and secondary windings of the rectifier transformer are measured. The results clarify the transient responses of the DC traction substation. The amplitude of the induced voltages on the primary windings is 76 % of that of the invaded phase. It shows a possibility that the failure due to lightning does not always occur on the invaded phase. In addition, the induced ratio of the secondary winding is 15 %, which is relatively high considering the winding ratio of the transformer of 5.3 %.

articleTitle: Safety Performance Evaluation of High Speed Railway Traction Substation Grounding Grid
abstract: With the continuous development of high-speed railways, more and more electronic equipment is introduced into high-speed railway traction substations, and the grounding grid is an important facility to ensure the normal operation of electrified railways and the safety of people and equipment in the station. The safety performance evaluation of the grounding grid of high-speed railway traction substation is essential for the design of the grounding engineering. In this study, The safety performance of the grounding grid was evaluated by a method of moment under a power frequency grounding fault and the lightning strike of the substation. The results show that while the grounding impedance of the traditional evaluation standard grounding grid meets the requirements, the contact voltage under the grounding grid power frequency grounding fault and the mesh potential difference under the lightning strike do not meet the safety standard.

articleTitle: Research on Cable Crane Lightning Protection for Hydroelectric Power Station Construction
abstract: The construction of the hydroelectric power station is a large civil engineering. The cable cranes in which the construction of the hydroelectric power station are mainly to transport concrete from high places to the dam, and the construction period is usually several years. The cable cranes are located at the high place of the construction site, including control and communication electronic equipment. In addition, the grounding resistance of the cable cranes is often high, which is easily hazarded by lightning stroke, thus affecting the progress and safety of the dam construction. However, lightning protection for cable crane is not fully considered and lack of relevant standard at present. In this paper, the structure and environmental characteristics of the cable cranes on construction site of hydroelectric power stations are investigated. The lightning protection zone of the cable crane is established according to IEC 62305-2010 (GB/T 21714-2015 equivalent Chinese version). The external lightning protection system and the internal surge protection measures of the cable cranes are designed. This lightning protection retrofit plan has been applied to several hydroelectric power station construction projects, such as Zangmu, Xiluodu, Xiangjiaba and Wudongde hydroelectric power Station, preventing a large number of lightning accidents of cable cranes and ensuring the safety and construction progress of the projects.

articleTitle: Development of SPD unit for HVDC system
abstract: Up until now, a 48-V DC system has been adopted as the power supply for communication facilities (which require high reliability). Along with the progress of the information society, the increase in power consumption due to the increase in the amount of ICT equipment has been a problem in terms of global warming. The high-voltage DC power-supply (HVDC) system (supplying voltages from DC 48 V to DC 400 V) can reduce initial cost and running cost, so it is currently attracting attention as a next-generation technology. The surge protective device (SPD) used for such a power supply (hereafter, referred to as “HVDC SPD”), which is applied to the rectifier DC section to protect the HVDC system from lightning surges and the like, has not been standardized at the present time. Referring to existing standards for AC SPDs and immunity standards for ICT equipment, in the present study, we have settled the requirements for an HVDC SPD and developed a prototype HVDC SPD unit. The prototype SPD unit was experimentally evaluated, and the results of that evaluation are presented in this report.

articleTitle: Research on Lightning Protection Assessment of The $Dis$ tribution Line Considering The Influence of Trees
abstract: The circumstance of distribution line is always complicated with trees and the pole is low. The trees will affect the lightning location and induced voltage in the rainy day. So the determine model and method of lightning location are advanced. The calculation method of induced voltage is supplied, which premeditating the influence of trees. Then, the model of lightning disaster risk assessment for distribution line is advanced, the specific line is assessment. The result shows that the lightning disaster risk assessment of pole is different with considering the trees or not. Though the trees had no effect on direct lightning, but induced voltage can be decreased by trees.

articleTitle: Cloud-Based Monitoring for SPDs using Advanced Measuring Methods for Lightning Disturbance
abstract: The increasing number of sensitive electrical equipment demands Surge Protective Devices (SPDs) with major challenges and a high degree of reliability. The enquiry for early-warning systems for unwanted and unexpected equipment failure is strongly rising over the last years. The integration of early warning systems as a condition monitoring in Industrial Internet of Things (1IoT) is in contrast to most of the common devices an unsolved subject in electric power distribution. This paper presents an advanced measuring method for lightning disturbance with cloud-based monitoring of SPDs. Due to an advanced bandwidth, this device is capable of the simultaneous measurement of low-energy Electromagnetic Interferences (EMI), high-energy lightning surge currents and finally long duration currents with amplitudes of about 300 A over several milliseconds. Therefore a new type of a retrofittable coreless current transformer has been developed. The induced signal is converted with a wide dynamic range and a linear frequency response. Results show that the signal is digitized with a high accuracy for the monitoring of SPDs to permit condition-oriented and predictive maintenance. The data transmission and storage is realized by a cloud solution and offers storage and Big Data processing options. The analysis allows an adaptation of iteratively improved aging models by increasing records of overvoltage events.

articleTitle: Influence of Grounding Modes on the Damage of Carbon Fiber Reinforced Plastics subjected to Lightning Strikes
abstract: Simulated lightning first return stroke currents (A component) were used to conduct lightning strike tests on CFRP samples with six different grounding modes. Visual inspection, optical microscope and scanning acoustic microscope were used to observe the top surface damage, internal damage and delamination of the tested samples. The analysis shows that the top surface damaged morphologies of the composites are similar under different grounding modes, but the damaged lengths have an obvious difference in different directions. Under the same grounding modes, whether the bottom surface of the samples is grounded or not, the internal damages are close to each other. The internal damages under the left-right-side-grounding, four-side-grounding and upper-down-side-grounding modes are different.

articleTitle: Measurement results of lightning current at Nikaho in winter from 2013 to 2017
abstract: Measurement of the lightning current waveforms have been carried out at Nikaho. In this study, we analyzed the current waveforms of 221 flashes obtained from 2013 to 2017, and 157 flashes were associated with negative lightning. In 99 cases the ICC was observed satisfactorily. We classified the current waveforms for a negative lightning into the 3 types based on the existence of return strokes and superimposing pulses with amplitude of higher than 2kA. The percentage of the current waveforms with the return stroke (RS) was 16.2%. As a result, the charge transfer of the current waveform that the ICC not followed by any RS but with one or more ICC pulses with amplitude of higher than 2kA was the largest. ICC with the large current peak value was observed frequently in this type. Possible reason is the weather condition. The charge transfer associated with the TWP (Typical winter air pressure pattern thunderstorm) is smaller than that associated with the others such as frontal or cyclonic thunderstorm. In this study, the same trend can be seen in all 3 types of current waveform.

articleTitle: Study on Flammability of Lightning Fire in Ancient Buildings in Shanghai
abstract: The characteristics of lightning environment around Jing'an Temple are obtained through statistical analysis of lightning monitoring data over the years in Shanghai. Based on the structural parameters and structural characteristics of the Daxiong Palace in Jing'an Temple, an experimental model for simulating the thermal effect of lightning stroke was established. The lightning current intensity of the simulation experiment was compared with the results of lightning environment analysis around Jing'an Temple. The corresponding lightning current was applied to the experimental model to observe the heating and ignition of the model material. It has a certain guiding role in lightning protection of existing ancient buildings in Shanghai.

articleTitle: Modeling of Cables for Lightning Analysis
abstract: Lightning impulses include very high frequency components, especially in the return stroke. For a proper lightning analysis of cables, it is important to make sure that the model adopted for cables is suitable for usage in high frequency region. Such a cable model should be able to calculate ground return impedances with high accuracy at high frequencies. Also this model should take displacement currents and ground admittance into consideration. Currently, there are no readily available cable models in EMT-type programs satisfying these three conditions. This paper describes implementation of a cable model in PSCAD-EMTDC, which satisfies these requirements. Some application examples are also provided in the paper to demonstrate the improvements achieved with this model.

articleTitle: Lightning Statistics Observed on Wind Turbines in Lightning-Susceptible Areas during Winter
abstract: Along the coast of the Sea of Japan, powerful lightning strikes during the winter are attracted to tall structures, often causing damage to wind turbines. A lightning detection device is set up on wind turbines during the winter in regions that are susceptible to lightning for the purpose of preventing the damage from spreading when the wind turbine is struck by lightning. In this study, the lightning data observed by the devices were accumulated, and the results of the investigation are reported based on the regional characteristics of lightning.

articleTitle: Overvoltage Response at Railway Insulators Based on Viaduct Configuration
abstract: Recently, the Hokuriku Shinkansen was built in an area that experiences extensive winter lightning. There is concern that damage may occur to the railway system if lightning were to strike the support structure on the viaduct. When a support structure is struck by lightning, the associated power surge may generate a flashover to the insulators between the trolley wires and support structures. In this paper, we present the influence of the viaduct construction configuration on the overvoltage between insulators using the finite difference time domain (FDTD) method.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Protection Effect of Lightning Shielded Wire of Buried Cable under Different Arrangements
abstract: Laying lightning shielded wire is one of the main measures for lightning protection of buried cables. In this paper, the electric field intensity calculation model of buried cable with lightning shielded wire is established by using finite element software, and the lightning protection effect of the shielded wire is analyzed. The study found that the different arrangement of buried cables has no significant effect on the maximum electric field of the cable. The increase in the number of lightning shielded wires will increase the lightning protection effect, but one has a good lightning protection effect in most cases. The radius of the shielded wire increases, and the protection effect becomes better. Considering the economy, the radius does not need to be too long. As the distance between the shielded wire and the cable increases, the protection effect first becomes better and then deteriorates.

articleTitle: Study on Difference of Ground Flash Density in Mountainous Areas and Presentation of mesoscopic terrain
abstract: Ground flash density is the basic parameter of various lightning protection projects. Obtaining a more accurate ground flash density can improve the precision of differential lightning protection for transmission lines. In this paper, the software Google Earth was used to select a grid area in the mountainous area of Guangdong Province, China. The software ArcGIS was used to make a statistical analysis of 10 years lightning localization system data in this selected area to obtain the 10 years average ground flash density distribution map of this area. The results show that there is a significant difference in ground flash density of mountainous areas. When calculating the lightning shielding failure trip-out rate of transmission lines, ignoring this difference will cause great errors. In order to further study this difference, this paper puts forward the concept of mesoscopic terrain and gives the definition of mesoscopic terrain.

articleTitle: Observations of the magnetic pulses in rocket-triggered lightning with sensitive magnetic sensor
abstract: With the observations in SHandong Triggering Lightning Experiment (SHATLE) and Comprehensive Observation Experiment on Lightning Discharge (GCOELD) in China, we investigate the magnetic pulses associated with the upward positive leaders during the initial stage of negative triggered lightning. The initial magnetic pulses (IMPs) measured at the very initial stage are corresponding to the sustained upward positive leaders, and can be divided into two categories (i.e., impulsive and ripple pulses) according to the discernibility of separation between individual pulses. The IMPs are generated by leader current pulses propagating downward along the steel wire. For the magnetic pulses measured during the stage of initial continuous current or called magnetic pulse bursts (MPBs) since these pulses last longer than IMPs, they are commonly observed both in SHATLE and GCOELD, even though the associated signals of electrical fields are not obvious. The heights of rocket upon the inception of the MPBs are at least about 268 m in our observations, and the average inter-pulse intervals are affected by the height significantly. The cases with higher height usually have shorter inter-pulse intervals. In comparison with the IMPs, the inter-pulse intervals of the MPBs contain more small time scale (<;20 μs) cases, since the speed of upward leaders show an accelerating tendency with height and time. MPBs are derived from the breakdown near the leader tip.

articleTitle: Analytical Study of Lightning Protection Performance by Excluding the Current-Limiting Arcing Horns of a Phase
abstract: We evaluated the lightning protection performance of a medium-voltage distribution line by excluding the arcing horn of the middle phase. The analysis model of the power distribution equipment and the lightning protection equipment of Chubu Electric Power Company were used to evaluate (a) the influence of the span length of the distribution poles, (b) the steepness of the lightning current, and (c) the grounding resistance of the lightning protection equipment. The lightning protection performance was evaluated as the minimum injection current when the interphase short circuit occurred. The minimum injection current tended to increase as the wave front steepness increased., and the span length decreased. The minimum injection current was decreased by not using a horn in the middle phase, and this current became much smaller when the phase conductors were twisted. The minimum current value increased as the ground resistance increased in the current state., and we excluded the arcing horn of one phase. However, the minimum current value was not affected by twisting the phase conductors.

articleTitle: Designing Lightning Protection, Earthing and Bonding System for Railways
abstract: There are a number of relevant standards which are widely used in designing lightning protection, earthing and bonding systems for railway facilities. However, since each railway is unique due to the use of different traction power supply systems, earthing arrangements and wayside equipment bonding strategies, hence, a holistic design must take into consideration all relevant system features in order to come up with an effectiveness lightning protection, earthing and bonding system design. This paper highlights some of the issues experienced, which shall be assessed carefully in the design of an integrated lightning protection, earthing and bonding system. This paper aims to raise awareness of the importance of a fully integrated lightning protection, earthing and bonding design for the protection of railway facilities.

articleTitle: Understanding the Flashover Characteristics across Stay Arm Insulator due to Lightning Stroke
abstract: The lightning strike on any electrical system hampers reliability of the system. In this work, the effect of lightning stroke on the flashover characteristics of stay arm insulator of a traction mast is studied. To understand the flashover characteristics across stay arm insulator, firstly the effect of lightning stroke with different peak magnitude and steepness is studied. Secondly the effect of lighting striking at different polarity of sinusoid conductor voltage is studied. It is observed that lightning stroke parameters affects the overvoltage characteristics across stay arm insulator. However flashover behavior largely depends on leader propagation and ionization of soil. The polarity of conductor voltage also affects overvoltage and flashover behavior. It is seen in either case, soil ionization and leader propagation behavior may explain the occurrence of flashover.

articleTitle: The Influence of Bonding Conditions on Lightning Current Distribution in Radio Base Stations
abstract: Accurate assessment of lightning current distribution among cables in radio base stations (RBSs) is vital for lightning protection design of the system. The bonding condition shows a significantly influence on the lightning current distribution. This paper adopts the partial element equivalent circuit method (PEEC) to analyze the current distribution in RBSs with different bonding conditions. Frequency variant parameter of cables, steel structure and the lossy ground are considered in the simulation. Five different bonding scenarios are discussed in the paper. The results are beneficial for lightning protection design in the RBSs.

articleTitle: Analysis of Characters of Lightning Activity and Lightning Disaster in Hunan
abstract: Based on the thunderstorm observation data from 1956 to 2013 of meteorological stations in Hunan, the lightning monitoring data from 2008 to 2017, and lightning disaster data from 2002 to 2017, the spatial and temporal distribution characteristics of lightening and lightning disaster in Hunan are analyzed. The results show that: the annual averaged days of thunderstorm in Hunan are 49.9 days, it is decreasing by the rate of 3.493d/10a; the CG lightning return stroke the whole province observed on average about 340,000 times per year; July and August are the peak months of the lightning return stroke; hourly distribution of lightning return stroke appeared as single-peak, the peak period is between 15 and 17 p.m.; Yueyang, Changsha, Huaihua and Shaoyang are lightning disaster-prone areas; most lightning casualties have occurred the rural, lightning protection safety work of the rural needs to be strengthened.

articleTitle: The risk and protection of lightning disaster in Potala Palace
abstract: Through the investigation of the lightning disaster in Potala Palace, it is found that Potala Palace is located in the position of lightning strike easily. The main factors that lead to lightning disaster are its self structure, the trees induce lightning, the change of the internal environment and the inductive thunder of the metal in the hall. The main losses caused by lightning stroke, such as fire and casualties, are analyzed. The basic principles of lightning protection in Potala Palace are discussed. It is proposed that the original jinding and all kinds of metal ornaments of the roof should be used as lightning protection system according to the discharge characteristics of lightning and the structural features of Tibetan heritage buildings.

articleTitle: Evidence for the connection between blue discharges and negative narrow bipolar events in deep convection
abstract: In this study, we report the precious observations of a thunderstorm with frequent negative Narrow bipolar events (NBEs) and examine the temporal and spatial relationship between seven blue discharges (including blue jets, blue starters and pixels) observed by ISUAL payload onboard FORMOSAT-2 satellite. Our analysis shows that nearly all blue discharges are associated with negative NBEs within 1ms, indicating that negative NBEs is most probably the initial event of blue discharges and could provide a convenient approach to detect blue discharges. Our work will enrich recognition about the relationship between intra-cloud discharges and upward lightning discharges.

articleTitle: Influence of double-component epoxy resin coating on the ablation characteristic of coated steel under simulated lightning continuing current
abstract: Ablation tests were conducted on uncoated steel sheets and the steel sheets painted with anticorrosion and antistatic coatings, with simulated lightning continuing currents of 200 A amplitude and 215 ms duration, respectively. The macroscopic and microscopic morphology of ablated area, rear-face temperature of tested samples and the arc voltage of simulated lightning current were analyzed comprehensively. It has been concluded that, for both the antistatic coated and anticorrosion coated samples, the size of the completely ablated area, in which coating film has been stripped completely from steel surface, decreases when the coating thickness increases from 100 μm to 400 μm. The size of completely ablated area on antistatic coated sample is larger than that on anticorrosion coated sample. The energy that the antistatic and anticorrosion coatings absorbed by decomposition is more than the energy they released by combustion, while the heat block effect of anticorrosion coating is more obvious than the antistatic coating. The ablation duration of antistatic coating is longer than that of anticorrosion coating. It increases gradually with coating thickness increasing, while the ablation duration of anticorrosion coating decreases slightly.

articleTitle: Influence of grounding wire configuration of traction substation
abstract: In this paper, the influence of grounding wire configuration of traction substation on observed transient overvoltage at some electric machines, those are diode rectifier, series reactor and so on, is experimentally measured. According to our previous experiences, a diode rectifier is the weakness against lightning and making the transient voltage smaller can increase the reliability of traction power supply system against lightning. Now, two grounding wires are installed separately at Ooi-Futo Substation. Throughout our experiments, by connecting them and by disconnecting the one end of grounding wire near the rectifier, it was confirmed that the transient voltage observed at diode rectifier could be decreased. In this paper, some experimental results will be explained in detail.

articleTitle: On the comparison of lightning fatality rates between states in Malaysia from 2008–2019
abstract: This study briefly canvasses lightning fatalities in Malaysia. Acquiring lightning fatality statics are a challenge as mandatory reporting of such events is seldom required, and as such, many lightning incidences were unreported. For that reason, numerous cases were undocumented in the official records. However, for injury prevention efforts and calling a government's attention to these as a severe problem, information on numbers, exposed locations and their backgrounds are essential to determine vulnerable areas. A theoretical approach using Gomes-Kadir equation was also tested to estimate annual lightning deaths in each state of Malaysia using lightning density and sociological factors and the results compared against known fatality data.

articleTitle: Lightning Proximity Warning System for Power Transmission Channel with Integrated Multi-sensor
abstract: With the rapid expansion of the power grid, lightning strikes are still the main cause of line failures. In order to further reduce the lightning risks, a lightning proximity warning system for power transmission channel with integrated multi-sensor is studied and developed. The system adopts a three-part structure consisting of the base station, central station, and application terminal. The lightning proximity warning system combines multi-sensor data including the atmospheric electric fields, lightning detection data, radar echoes, and satellite cloud images. The corresponding methods including the dynamic self-adapting threshold values, density-based spatial clustering of applications with noise algorithm, thunderstorm identification, cloud movement curve predict with cubic spline interpolation function are used and combined to realizing the lightning proximity warning. The system has covered 16 power companies at provincial level with more than 300 base stations, and formed a lightning proximity warning network covering the main UHV DC transmission channels of SGCC. The system has been running for some years and has issued thousands of warning messages, which plays an important role in ensuring the safe operation of the power grid. The specific case is given and shows that the early warning effect is very good.

articleTitle: Characteristics of Lightning Attachment Point Distributions on Wind Turbine Blades under Downward Lightning
abstract: As the highest component of wind turbines, the blades are vulnerable to lightning damages. The existing calculation models either cannot give characteristics of lightning attachment point distributions on wind turbine blades or lack well-developed physical processes. Besides, the optimization of the blade lightning protection system design is short of the guidance of calculation results. Based on the self-consistent leader inception and propagation model, a calculation method for characteristics of lightning attachment point distributions on wind turbine blades during the development of the downward leader was proposed in this paper. The lightning strike probability of six typical locations on the 2MW wind turbine blade surface was calculated using the ratio of lightning collection area, and the maximum lightning current of tip shielding failure was defined as well. The prospective return stroke current amplitude, the downward leader original position and the blade rotational angle were taken into consideration as three independent random variables, of which the effects on distribution characteristics of lightning attachment points were also evaluated. Calculation results showed that the rotational angle significantly affected the maximum lightning current of tip shielding failure. The protection scope of the blade tip was strongly influenced by rotor orientations, while the probability of the blade tip being struck is as high as 91.13%, which is much higher than the probabilities of the other locations along the blade. What's more, the probability of lightning strike in the region far from the tip (40 meters) is about twice that of regions near the tip (20-30 meters). Compared with the actual wind farm fault statistics, the reason for the high probability being struck in the area away from the tip is mainly related to the downward lightning strike. The characteristics of lightning attachment point distributions on the wind turbine blade calculated in this paper could provide theoretical basis for the design and optimization of blade lightning protection system.

articleTitle: Observation and Analysis Results of an Electrical Field Sounding System
abstract: A balloon-borne sounding system was designed to measure the vertical electric field, humidity, temperature and precipitation particle (size and type of ice phase) within thunderstorm. Based on the principle of GPS tracking, a ground-based automatic tracking and transceiver system (hereinafter referred to as the ground system) was designed to receive all signals transmitted from the sounding continuously. Some results obtained by this system had been introduced in this paper. A result of a sounding measurement in Aug.22 2016 in the inland plateau of China shows that total four charge regions were found in the mature stage of a thunderstorm and charge polarity was alternate in a vertical direction with a negative charge region at the lowest in the warm cloud region. Another result of a sounding measurement in Aug.26 2018, obtained above the tropical island of China, shows that at the dissipation stage of the thunderstorm, there is a positive polar charge zone in the warm cloud, while there is a strong negative charge zone near <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0\square$</tex> level and a positive charge zone above. This system could adapt to different environments and obtain valid data of electric field (E). However, in actual observation, there was still some shortness in obtaining the information of ice phase particles image.

articleTitle: LiOn Return Stroke Peak Current Analysis for Ground Strike Points in the Austrian Alps
abstract: This paper presents an analysis related to the research project “Lightning Observation in the Alps” (LiOn) carried out by Graz University of Technology in cooperation with the Austrian Lightning Detection and Information System (ALDIS). Atmospheric discharges were observed at 21 different measurement locations in Austria by using a video and field recording system. The system consists of two main components, a high speed video camera and a flat plate antenna. The recorded ground truth data should help to get additional information about atmospheric discharge processes, especially in the alpine area. For this analysis, a dataset of negative cloud-to-ground strokes of the measurement periods 2015, 2017 and 2018 was used. In this analysis, we compare peak currents of first return strokes (LLS flash data) with peak currents of first strokes in a GSP. The GSPs are determined manually by using the video data. We especially considered the relation of first initial (FI) peak currents versus subsequent (SU) peak currents. The stroke peak current versus the multiplicity for flashes and strokes per GSP was investigated too. For all the analyses in this paper, the Austrian Lightnig Location System (ALDIS) provided the data for the stroke peak currents. In 42 % of the flashes, at least one SU peak current in a flash shows a greater value compared to the FI stroke in this flash. Checking the peak currents within GSPs reveals 37 % with at least one SU stroke with a larger peak current than the FI stroke in the same GSP. The analysis of the percentage of SU strokes with peak currents greater than the FI stroke reveals the same value of 14 % for flashes and per GSPs. Regarding the analysis of FI peak currents versus the multiplicity, the results show an increase for both analyses leading to higher peak currents for the FI strokes exhibiting a larger multiplicity.
